scope: Phase 6 of the RunMyCampus platform-wide workflow audit. Catalogs every tenant-side primary workflow (Studio OS in tenant mode, onboarding, setup chains, marks/attendance/reports, money fallback, migration cloud customer view, marketplace, feedback, help) against a fixed schema covering audience, click count, primary/next/readiness/blocker/completion state visibility, help/AI/feedback hooks, admin clutter signals, platform-only leakage signals, and mobile-safe signal. Read-only walk over config/tenant_urls.py (verified 93 routes), apps/portal/urls.py (verified 120 routes), apps/portal/urls_kb.py, apps/siteconfig/urls.py (verified 638 lines), apps/finance/urls.py (verified 28 routes), apps/migration_cloud/urls_customer.py (verified 6 routes) + urls_guardian_consent.py, apps/marketplace/tenant_urls.py, apps/feedback/urls.py, apps/communication/urls.py, apps/evals/urls.py, and templates/portal/, templates/parent/, templates/teacher/, templates/student/, templates/siteconfig/, templates/finance/. Spot-checks: school_studio_hub @ tenant_urls.py:286, tenant_offboarding @ tenant_urls.py:292, school_setup_imports @ tenant_urls.py:270, guided_configuration_workflows @ siteconfig/urls.py:210, finance:dashboard @ finance/urls.py:34, evals:teacher_marks_entry @ evals/urls.py:34, migration-intake-list @ migration_cloud/urls_customer.py:27. Complement to ai_tenant_studio_audit_first_inventory.json (does not duplicate).
